highlight.title: Harry Wild
highlight.badge: Acorn TV Original · Season 5 · Premieres June 22
highlight.description: Jane Seymour returns as the sharp, fearless Harry Wild — retired professor turned amateur sleuth in Dublin. Season 5 brings a surprise reunion with Joe Lando (Dr. Quinn, Medicine Woman) and a fresh batch of clever Irish mysteries. One of Acorn TV's most beloved originals.

new_arrivals.title: Harry Wild
new_arrivals.description: Jane Seymour is back as Dublin's most irrepressible amateur detective. Season 5 surprises with a Dr. Quinn reunion — Joe Lando guest stars alongside Seymour in a fresh run of witty Irish mysteries. Weekly episodes through the summer.

new_arrivals.title: Art Detectives
new_arrivals.description: DI Mick Palmer (Stephen Moyer) and DC Shazia Malik solve murders connected to the world of art and antiques — from Old Master paintings to Banksy street art, medieval manuscripts and collectible vinyl. Six episodes, each a gloriously different corner of the art world. Exactly the kind of clever, stylish British mystery your community loves.

new_arrivals.title: Summerwater
new_arrivals.description: Dougray Scott and Shirley Henderson lead this atmospheric British drama set over one long, tense summer weekend at a Scottish lochside holiday park. Six episodes, new weekly — quiet, beautifully observed, and utterly gripping.

new_arrivals.title: Murdoch Mysteries
new_arrivals.description: The beloved Victorian-era Toronto detective series continues with the back half of Season 19. Detective William Murdoch uses forensic techniques ahead of his time to solve crimes in 1900s Canada. A comfort watch for fans of period mysteries.

new_arrivals.title: You're Killing Me
new_arrivals.description: Brooke Shields stars as a bestselling novelist who teams up with an aspiring podcaster to solve her friend's murder in a quaint New England town. Warm, witty, and completely bingeable — a cozy mystery with genuine charm.

originals.title: Midsomer Murders
originals.description: The ultimate comfort watch — impossibly picturesque English villages with an impossibly high murder rate. 25+ series of warm, witty, completely addictive mystery. The show that defines cozy British TV.

originals.title: Agatha Raisin
originals.description: Ashley Jensen is irresistible as the sharp London PR exec who retires to the Cotswolds and keeps stumbling into murders. Funny, warm, and completely bingeable — based on M.C. Beaton's beloved novels.

originals.title: Harry Wild
originals.description: Jane Seymour at her absolute best — witty, fearless, and completely charming as Dublin's most unlikely detective. All five seasons now streaming. Start from the beginning and you won't stop.

originals.title: Doc Martin
originals.description: A grumpy London surgeon retreats to a tiny Cornish fishing village as its GP. Ten series of the warmest, funniest comedy drama British TV has produced. Port Wenn is the village you'll wish you lived in.
